claims.claim: SHARP 通过单次前馈在标准 GPU 上以不到 1 秒的时间回归出场景的 3D 高斯表示参数。
claims.quote: Given a single photograph, SHARP regresses the parameters of a 3D Gaussian representation of the depicted scene. This is done in less than a second on a standard GPU via a single feedforward pass through a neural network.

claims.claim: SHARP 产出的 3D 高斯表示可以被实时渲染，生成附近视角的高分辨率写实图像。
claims.quote: The 3D Gaussian representation produced by SHARP can then be rendered in real time, yielding high-resolution photorealistic images for nearby views.

claims.claim: 该表示是 metric 的，带绝对尺度，支持米制的相机运动。
claims.quote: The representation is metric, with absolute scale, supporting metric camera movements.

claims.claim: 实验结果展示了 SHARP 跨数据集的鲁棒零样本泛化能力。
claims.quote: Experimental results demonstrate that SHARP delivers robust zero-shot generalization across datasets.

claims.claim: 在多个数据集上，SHARP 相对此前最佳模型把 LPIPS 降低 25–34%、DISTS 降低 21–43%，同时把合成耗时降低三个数量级。
claims.quote: It sets a new state of the art on multiple datasets, reducing LPIPS by 25–34% and DISTS by 21–43% versus the best prior model, while lowering the synthesis time by three orders of magnitude.

claims.claim: 预测结果是以 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）形式存放在输出目录中的可渲染结果。
claims.quote: The results will be 3D gaussian splats (3DGS) in the output folder.

claims.claim: 官方 CLI 的预测入口是 sharp predict，用 -i 指定输入图像目录、-o 指定输出高斯目录。
模型权重在第一次运行时自动下载，并缓存到 ~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/。
claims.quote: The model checkpoint will be downloaded automatically on first run and cached locally at `~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/`.

claims.claim: 高斯预测在 CPU、CUDA 和 MPS 上都能工作，但通过 --render 渲染相机轨迹视频目前需要 CUDA GPU。
claims.quote: While the gaussians prediction works for all CPU, CUDA, and MPS, rendering videos via the `--render` option currently requires a CUDA GPU.

claims.claim: 输出的 3DGS 遵循 OpenCV 坐标约定（x 右、y 下、z 前），场景中心大致在 (0, 0, +z)，接第三方渲染器时需要自行缩放与旋转来重新居中。
claims.quote: We follow the OpenCV coordinate convention (x right, y down, z forward). The 3DGS scene center is roughly at (0, 0, +z). When dealing with 3rdparty renderers, please scale and rotate to re-center the scene accordingly.
